openings.claim: Plywood corner datums and axial stops locate rods before hand-operated M5 pressure members restrain them. Tether movable members and nuts with cord; loops retain them. Replace dependence on tight enclosing clearance with deliberate seating before clamping; tighter enclosure may trap a rod before its stop. Construction candidate only.
openings.discriminator: If incomplete seating explains the reversal, datum-first seating should reduce unloaded return error versus enclosing contact. Tightening may improve loaded stability without improving return error. Equal seating with similar return weakens that explanation. An 18 mm substitution may reveal centerline or pointer-offset dependence despite repeatable face seating.
openings.probe: Within 100 fabrication minutes, build one reversible corner/stop fixture with optional enclosing contact using six 80x40x6 mm plywood pieces, eight M5 bolts/nuts, four washers, two loops, cord and supplied tools. Drill plywood only; no rod drilling, adhesive or permanent marks. Verify captive components, hand-only access/adjustment, 90 mm cube envelope and fastening geometry. Compare two configurations: five exchanges of each 19/20 mm rod, then two 18 mm substitutions each; log time/unloaded error. Four ten-second 10 N trials each cover initial assembly, fifth exchange of each original rod and final substitution; log target escape. At forty seconds/exchange, twenty testing minutes leave only 160 seconds for switching, load setup and logging; infeasible timing leaves comparison unresolved.
openings.uncertainty: Rod orientation/pointer attachment permitting fixed face datums are unspecified. Available materials must realize stiff captive members within envelope/time. Defeats: inconsistent stop contact, contact crushing, clamp slip, angular amplification beyond 2 mm, substitution-dependent offset, loose components or exchanges exceeding forty seconds. Two reversal trials, including tighter fit returning 3 mm farther, establish no cause.

lineage.reason: Retains seating/restraint relation, rival, predictions, feasibility caveats and defeats.

decision: Probe only if both configurations and measurement timing are realizable. Require return within the 2 mm target and retention there under 10 N for ten seconds, each exchange under forty seconds and no component falling free. Complete performance remains unproven; no deployment follows.
